description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Parry Stance

Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA.
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Havoc

Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Parry Stance

Tahan Normal Attack untuk memasuki Parry Stance dengan mengorbankan STA.
Selama aktif, Rover kebal terhadap interupsi, menerima 60% lebih sedikit DMG, dan terus-menerus mengonsumsi STA. Lepas Normal Attack untuk keluar dari Parry Stance dan melakukan Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, memberikan Electro DMG.
Jika serangan mengenai Rover selama periode tertentu pada Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, serangan tersebut dinetralkan dan target ditahan sementara (Stagnation) sebelum melakukan Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, memberikan Electro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Riposte Strike untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Havoc
Dalam Parry Stance, gunakan Dodge untuk mengonsumsi STA dan melakukan Dodge: Flicker, yang dapat memicu Dodge berhasil selama aksi skill ini sesaat setelah dilancarkan.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dari udara, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Havoc

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG. Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Tahap 3 skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Repel.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelahnya untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengorbankan STA, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Overshock

At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by pressing the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 points of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

Apex Resonance

While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, press Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 stage: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Press Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, press Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

Electric Surge

Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

Thunder Rage

Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.
description.id:
Overshock

Saat Electric Surge maksimal, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Resonance Skill Overshock, memberikan Electro DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melakukan Normal Attack Tahap 4.
Skill ini dapat dilancarkan di udara.
Jika Resonance Skill Overshock dilancarkan dengan menekan tombol, hapus seluruh Electric Surge untuk memberikan ATK Bonus sebesar 10% kepada Resonator di tim selama 20 dtk.
Jika Resonance Skill Overshock dilancarkan dengan menahan tombol, konsumsi 60 poin Concerto Energy untuk memberikan damage, lalu hapus seluruh Electric Surge untuk memasuki Apex Resonance.

Apex Resonance

Saat dalam Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds terbuka, yang mengonsumsi 10% Thunder Rage per detik:
Saat di darat, tekan Resonance Skill untuk melancarkan hingga 7 serangan beruntun:
- 3 tahap pertama: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, memberikan Spectro DMG.
- 3 tahap berikutnya: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, memberikan Havoc DMG.
- 1 tahap terakhir: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, memberikan Aero DMG.
Saat di darat, tahan Resonance Skill untuk melancarkan Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, memberikan Aero DMG dan melompat ke udara.
Saat di udara, tekan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan hingga 6 tahap Mid-air Attack:
- 3 tahap pertama: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.
- 2 tahap berikutnya: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, memberikan Aero DMG dan menyembuhkan seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
- 1 tahap terakhir: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG. Tekan Resonance Skill sesaat setelah mendarat untuk melancarkan Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Tahan Resonance Skill di udara untuk melancarkan Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Setiap kali Thrum of All Sounds mengenai target, Thunder Bane terpicu, memberikan Electro DMG ke target dalam jangkauan, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Saat dalam Apex Resonance, tekan Resonance Skill sesaat setelah melancarkan Basic Attack untuk menyambung ke skill Thrum of All Sounds tertentu sesuai Tahap Basic Attack yang berbeda.

Electric Surge

Rover dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Electric Surge.
Electric Surge dipulihkan saat Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, atau Basic Attack - Repel memberikan damage.

Thunder Rage

Rover dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Thunder Rage.
Memasuki Apex Resonance memulihkan Thunder Rage hingga batas maksimal.
Thunder Rage dipulihkan saat Thrum of All Sounds memberikan damage.

description.en:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.
description.id:
Resonator yang masuk mendapat Electro Core selama 20 dtk atau hingga Resonator tersebut diganti keluar. Setelah Resonator dengan Electro Core menimbulkan Negative Status, Electro Core mereka dikonsumsi, dan mereka mendapat Amplify All DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek.
Melancarkan Outro Skill mengakhiri kondisi Apex Resonance dan menghapus seluruh Thunder Rage.
